generalCriterionList.description: Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka.

The bidder shall quote his rates exclusive of GST but inclusive of all other applicable taxes, royalty, levies, duties, and Building Workers Welfare Cess at 1% etc., as per the latest GoK and GoI at prevailing rates as on last date of receipt of tender.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Tender document is part and parcel of agreement.
Conditional tenders are liable for rejection.
The contractor shall follow minimum wages act and other statutory acts and its amendments.
KPCL shall recover the Income Tax, building workers welfare cess, at the prevailing applicable rates.

The successful tenderer shall furnish a Contract performance guarantee (CPG)/Security deposit (SD) equivalent to 5% of the contract price in the form of e-BG from any Nationalized/Scheduled Bank acceptable to the Corporation in the prescribed format within 20 days from the date of issue of Letter of Award from KPCL. The CPG/SD shall remain valid for the entire contract period, including the Defect Liability Period (DLP) of 12 months from the date of actual completion of the work, plus 30 days or the e-BG shall be extended until the final bill is passed by the Division, whichever is later, and shall execute the agreement within scheduled time, failing which will attract penalty.

The tenderer is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at tenderers end.
The original documents should be produced for verification at any stage of tender process as and when sought for, failing which, the bids are liable for disqualification.
Rates shall be quoted in price schedule in the website itself.
The tender shall be valid for 180 days from the date of receipt of tender.
The tenderer shall comply all the GST requirements.

The contractor shall quote his rates inclusive of PF as per the applicable rate as issued by the PF department from time to time and if any variation occurs it shall be paid / refunded by / to the Corporation against documentary evidence.

The tenderer shall register himself under section 7 and their worker who will be engaged for the work under section 12 of the building and other construction workers act 1996. If not the successful tenderer may do so immediately before award of work
The successful tenderer shall give an undertaking that they would abide by the provisions of the Employees Provident Fund Act.
The tenderer shall obtain insurance coverage for all the workers deployed for this work.

The bidder should take into account the prevailing royalty charges while quoting their rates and shall be deducted from the work bills. The successful bidder shall strictly adhere to Rule 36 & 42 of Karnataka Mineral Concession Rules 1994 & its amendments thereof If the successful bidder/agency fails to furnish documents related to remittance of royalty charges for Coarse aggregate, Fine aggregate, murrum etc., as per Rule 44(4) of Karnataka Mineral Concession (amendment) Rules 2016, following penalty will be recovered from the work bills. (i)A penalty of 5 times the royalty amount or A penalty of Rs.1500/- per ton for building stone and Rs. 3000/- per ton for sand as per Schedule I-C in addition to royalty charges.(ii)A penalty of 30% of total royalty amount and the same will be transferred to District Mineral Foundation Trust as per rule 36(A).

The bidder should maintain register of workers deployed and wages paid for the workers and shall produce the documents whenever called for by the competent authority. Remittance towards PF shall be commensurate with the labour component of the work involved.
Bidder should have independent PF code. The bidder shall remit PF of labourers to Contractors permanent PF code number only and not to the KPCL PF sub code.
In case the dates notified above declared as holiday, the immediate next working day will be reckoned
If the Bidder makes any alterations in the conditions of the contract or puts any condition of his own, such tenders are liable for rejection.
Further details of the work or any clarifications can be obtained from the office of the Executive Engineer (OLA) Civil, BTPS, KPCL, Kudithini-58315, during office hours. Mobile-91-9141607350
Corrigendum/modification/corrections, if any, will be published in the web site only.
Any variation in labour wages made by the Government from time to time shall be borne by the agency. Any claim towards this variation will not be entertained by KPCL.
The bidder shall quote item rates on the basis of prevailing market rate.

In case of death of a contractor after executing the agreement/commencement of the work, his legal heir (to be intimated at the time of execution of agreement by the successful contractor), if any eligible registered contractor and willing, can execute and complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work after obtaining approval from competent authority.
Any Eligible reputed individual/company registered in KPWD Class-IV & above contractors are eligible to apply and a certificate issued by the respective department in this regard shall be furnished.

technicalCriterionList.description: Assessed available tender capacity (AxNx2.5-B) should be greater than the amount put to tender, were, A-Maximum value of works executed in any one year during the last five years (updated to 2026-27) price level taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N-Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited for 0.33 years (04 months). B - Value of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 0.33 years(04 months). The signed copy of available tender capacity calculation sheet shall be uploaded.

Intending bidder shall furnish annual turnover certificate for the preceding five financial years i.e,(2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26) duly certified by the chartered accountant for calculation of tender capacity with valid UDIN. (Weightage of 10% per year will be given to the financial turnover of previous years to bring them to the price level of present financial year)

itemList.description: Demolishing R.C.C. work manually/ by mechanical means including stacking of steel bars and disposal of unserviceable material to the appropriate disposal area as per direction of Engineer-in-charge.

Demolishing brick work manually/by mechanical means including stacking of serviceable material and disposal of unserviceable material to the appropriate disposal area as per direction of Engineer-in-charge. - In cement mortar.

Demolishing brick work manually/by mechanical means including stacking of serviceable material and disposal of unserviceable material to the appropriate disposal area as per direction of Engineer-in-charge.

Dismantling doors, windows and clerestory windows (steel or wood) shutter including chowkhats, architrave, holdfasts etc. complete and stacking to the appropriate disposal area as per direction of Engineer-in-charge.
Cutting and removing jauliflora bushes upto 1.50 m girth excluding removal of stumps and including burning or disposing off the materials as directed with all other ancillary operations complete.

Earth work excavation for Foundation by mechanical means for all works & depth upto 3 m, as per drawing and technical specifications, including setting out, shoring, strutting, barricading, caution lights, including dressing of excavated surfaces, disposing off or levelling the excavated earth or sorting & stacking the selected earth for reuse in a radius of 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m including cost of labour, tools, usage of machinery & other appurtenaces required to complete the work - In all kinds of soils Depth upto 3 m

Providing and Filling in foundation with available coal lumps and available approved ash including hand packing, ramming, watering, including cost of all materials and labour with all lead and lift. complete as per specifications.

Finishing walls with 100% Premium acrylic emulsion paint having VOC less than 50 g/L and UV resistance as per IS 15489:2004, Alkali & fungal resistance, dirt resistance exterior paint of required shade (Company Depot Tinted) with silicon additives, New work (Two coats applied @ 1.43 L/ 10 m². Over and including priming coat of exterior primer applied @ 0.90 L/10 m² with paint of approved quality to give an even shade, after thoroughly brooming the surface to remove all dirt, dust, mortar drops and foreign matter including preparing the surface even and sand paper smooth, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.

Distempering with 1st quality acrylic distemper (ready mixed) having VOC content less than 50 g/l, of approved manufacturer, of required shade and colour complete, as per manufacturer's specification. Two coats on new work to give an even shade after thoroughly brooming the surface to remove all dirt, dust, mortar drops and foreign matter including preparing the surface even and sand paper smooth, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.

Wall painting with acrylic emulsion paint of approved brand and manufacture to give an even shade :Two coats on new work after thoroughly brooming the surface to remove all dirt, dust, mortar drops and foreign matter including preparing the surface even and sand paper smooth, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.

Repairs to plaster in patches of 2.5 m2 and less in walls, ceilings 10 to 20mm thick in cement mortar 1:4 including cutting the patches in proper shape and replastering the surface of the wall including disposal of rubbish with a lead of 50m including curing cost of materials, labour, complete as per specification.

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for levelling course for all works in foundation. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing, and all the other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. Mix 1:2:4 Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates

Providing Brick work with clay flyash Non Modular brick of class designation 3.5 in superstructure above plinth level up to floor I level in Cement mortar 1:4 (1 cement : 4 coarse sand) including cost of all materials, labour, scaffolding and usage charges of machinery & other incidental charges complete as per the direction of engineer incharge of work.

Providing and laying in position Cement Concrete for all Sub structures of building, Irrigation works, Sub structure works of bridges, Drain works & other parallel works from 0.50m to 3.50 m height. The granite/trap/basalt crushed graded coarse aggregates and fine aggregates as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers, laid in layers, well compacted using needle vibrators, providing weep holes wherever necessary, including all lead & lifts, cost of all materials of quality, confirming to the requirements of relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. M25 Design mix using 20mm nominal size graded crushed coarse aggregates. Including formwork

Providing and constructing un-reinforced plain cement concrete pavement, thickness as per design, over a prepared sub base, with 43 grade cement or any other type as per Clause 1501.2.2 M30 (Grade), coarse and fine aggregates conforming to IS:383, maximum size of coarse aggregate not exceeding 25 mm, mixed in a concrete mixer of not less than 0.2 cum capacity and appropriate weigh batcher using approved mix design, laid in approved fixed side formwork (steel channel, laying and fixing of 125 micron thick polythene film, wedges, steel plates including levelling the formwork as per drawing), spreading the concrete with shovels, rakes,compacted using needle, screed and plate vibrators and finished in continuous operation including construction joints, , primer, sealant , curing of concrete slabs for 14- days, and water finishing to lines and grade as per drawing and technical specification clause 1501 with all lead, lifts, loading & unloading charges, cost and conveyance of all materials, labour, equipments etc., complete. as per the directions of the Engineer-in-charge of the work.

Supplying, fitting and placing TMT FE 550 / 550D Steel Reinforcement including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cleaning, straightening, cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification)

Providing and laying insitu vibrated cement concrete M-25 using approved clean, hard, graded aggregates including cost of all materials, machinery, labour, cleaning, batching, mixing, placing in position, levelling, vibrating, finishing, curing etc., complete with all leads and lifts. (For Power House and Allied works) Using 10mm and down coarse aggregates and 28 days cube compressive strength, Cement content=410kg/m3

Providing and fixing 1mm thick M.S. sheet door with frame of 40x40x6 mm angle iron and 3 mm M.S. gusset plates at the junctions and corners, all necessary fittings complete, including applying a priming coat of approved steel primer. Using M.S. angels 40x40x6 mm for diagonal braces including cost of materials, labour, usage charges of machinery complete as per specifications and as per directions of the Engineer-in-Charge.

Filling available excavated earth (excluding rock) in trenches, plinth, sides of foundations and other similar works etc. in layers not exceeding 20cm in depth, consolidating each deposited layer by ramming and watering, lead up to 50 m and lift upto 1.5 m.
Disposing of excess excavated muck through tippers/tractors to the designated dump yard including labour cost, machineries, transportation etc., and as direction of Engineer-in-charge

Painting with synthetic enamel paint of approved brand and manufacture to give an even shade :Two coats on new work after thoroughly brooming the surface to remove all dirt, dust, mortar drops and foreign matter including preparing the surface even and sand paper smooth, cost of materials, labour complete as per specifications and as per directions of Engineer-in-charge.
